Anna (DevEx): Morning — quick check-in on SDK quickstarts, sample apps, and a couple doc fixes.
Mike (DevEx): Thanks. High level?
Anna (DevEx): Yesterday: merged the TypeScript quickstart edits, added explicit auth section, bumped examples to v0.4.0.
Chris (Docs): Nice. Which PR? :eyes: 
Anna (DevEx): https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-examples/pull/198 — small README reorganize + install steps.
Jen (SDK): Heads up: the Python wheel build is failing on Ubuntu 22.04 in CI, seeing linker errors with libmkl.
Mike (DevEx): Can you paste the failing log?
Jen (SDK): Sure:
```
Collecting .
  Running setup.py bdist_wheel for inference-sdk ... error
  LINK : fatal error LNK1104: cannot open file 'mkl_rt.lib'
```
Jen (SDK): I've pinned numpy to 1.25 in a branch to test, but not sure if that's the right move.
Chris (Docs): Blocker for quickstarts?
Jen (SDK): Slight. Local wheel still builds in mac environment. CI Linux is flaky. I can add a note in quickstart telling users to use `pip install inference-sdk==0.3.5` for now.
Anna (DevEx): Okay add the note as temporary workaround. I'll open a docs PR for that and ping here.
Anna (DevEx): PR for docs workaround: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
Mike (DevEx): Will review later today. Also, sample-apps repo has a failing E2E that looks like a dataset path mismatch — I opened an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/57
Anna (DevEx): I can take the sample-apps issue after docs PR merges.
Jen (SDK): FYI I'm looping in infra to re-run the Linux builder with extra logging: @mike could you add the builder tag?
Mike (DevEx): Done — re-run queued :rocket:
deploy-bot: CI re-run started for job inference-sdk-linux-build #8472
Chris (Docs): Small doc fix I pushed: normalize code block language tags and add note about config envs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/4b2e9f
Anna (DevEx): Blockers: none blocking release right now; just want reviews and CI green.
Mike (DevEx): My today: review SDK PRs, merge docs workaround, follow up on sample-apps dataset path.
Jen (SDK): Today: debug Linux builder logs, try a reproducible Docker dev image, and add a CI tag to skip heavy MKL steps.
Chris (Docs): Today: ship the temporary doc note and start converting quickstarts to unified snippets.
Anna (DevEx): If anyone reviews my docs PR, please leave short notes — I want to land before EOD PST. Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
Mike (DevEx): Will do.
Jen (SDK): Thanks all.
Anna (DevEx): closing loop — will post update once CI passes.
